name: Steve Chen
summary: Steve Chen, a former PayPal engineer, co-founded YouTube in 2005 with Chad Hurley and Jawed Karim and sold it to Google in 2006. He went on to co-found AVOS Systems with Hurley, joined Google Ventures in 2014, and in 2016 co-founded the live food-video site Nom, which closed in 2017.
